body:
## Purpose
Make the documentation build faster and drop Plots.jl from the docs, so that all figures use CairoMakie.

## Content
A few different things:
- A few figure scripts took a long time because they rebuilt parameter structs within loops (e.g., ~L35 in `docs/src/plots/MarshallPalmer_distribution.jl`). Now, we build parameters once.
- Including the `Parcel` model as a script caused fresh compilation for every example that used it. I moved the code into a new "package" so the code only needs to compile once.
    - note: tests and paper scripts still `include(parcel/src/Parcel.jl)` because `[sources]` (in `Project.toml`) requires Julia 1.11 or later.
- removed `Plots.jl` in favor of `CairoMakie.jl`. One fewer plotting package to precompile. This also removed `GR`, `Measures`, and `StatsPlots`.
- Rasterize large SVG images.
- Fixed an issue with the terminal velocity docs page that persisted since #779.

As a result, docs only takes about 1m20s in a fresh session and <30s rebuilding a 2nd time from REPL.
Latest main took 12 mins to build and deploy ([link](https://github.com/CliMA/CloudMicrophysics.jl/actions/runs/36175582848/job/108205255161)). This PR takes 4 mins for the same.

Other figure fixes:
- Three scripts set a global Makie theme, which affects unrelated plots (Makie themes are "global"). They now scope the theme with `with_theme`.
- The below-freezing snow-rain accretion figure plotted three flat lines, because its loop variable was unused. It now varies the snow specific content.
- A trailing comma turned one P3 panel title into a tuple.
- The Alpert and Knopf box figures and the 2M terminal velocity figure use a fixed random seed, so they no longer change between builds.
- The Alpert and Knopf backward script zero-initializes its freezing-event counts; the last element was uninitialized memory, which failed the docs build on some runs.
- Plotting calls pass their axis explicitly, and `Figure` uses `size` instead of the deprecated `resolution`.

The test environment no longer bounds LoweredCodeUtils. The bound held JET at 0.11.4, because JET 0.11.6 and later require LoweredCodeUtils 3.7.2 or newer. With JET 0.12.2, the JET checks in `performance_tests.jl` pass.

---

Thanks to Claude for doing all the hard work here.
title: Faster documentation build with CairoMakie figures and a Parcel package
